name: Satori to Yamaboushi
source:
Following a shocking incident in Yamato, young girl Tsubaki began volunteering.
On her first day, she met an elderly person who even the staff at the care home avoided.
The bitter old one smiled for the first time in ages, and began to tell a story...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE089255.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
大和發生了一起令人震驚的事件後，少女椿開始擔任志工。
第一天，她便遇見一位連安養院員工都避之不及的老人。
這位性情乖戾的老人露出了久違的笑容，隨後講起一個故事……
